ms.report:
A. Output: Proof of Concept (PoC) of the Blockchain Voting System
Acceptance criteria:
The Proof of Concept demonstrates the functionality and feasibility of a blockchain-based system applied to electoral processes. It includes the implementation of a hybrid architecture where blockchain (Cardano) is used as an audit and verification layer, while off-chain systems manage critical processes such as scanning, digitization, and quality control. The PoC validates traceability across all stages and ensures data integrity through cryptographic hashes and metadata recorded on the blockchain.
Evidence:
General repository: https://github.com/democracyonchain/
PoC results: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-documents/blob/main/docs/Proof%20of%20Concept%20results(EN).pdf
Closing video: https://vimeo.com/manage/videos/1174237935
Source Code:
Desktop applications: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-desktop
Transactional backend: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-backend
Transactional frontend: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-frontend
Blockchain component: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-blockchain
Public frontend for traceability: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-frontend-traceability
Traceability backend: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-backend-traceability
IPFS component: https://github.com/democracyonchain/asuncion-ipfs
B. Output: Final Report
Acceptance criteria:
The final report provides a comprehensive overview of the project, including objectives, methodology, architecture, implementation, results, and conclusions. It includes detailed documentation of the PoC implementation, highlighting technical decisions, system design, and the integration between blockchain, backend systems, and IPFS. It also presents recommendations for future improvements or deployment in real-world environments.
